zh: 首个公开版本，作为后续版本的兼容基线。
节点订阅：把节点挂到市场按天、流量或 95 带宽出售；订阅来的节点还能和自有节点组合后再转售。
动态路由：站点是数据，不是配置文件：增删改不 reload，为百万站设计。
自适应 WAF：按站点真实流量自动调整误报排除，官方规则库免费更新。
智能自动防御：节点本地学习基线，攻击开始后秒级自动处置，结束后自动撤销。
聚合边缘：绑定自己的 Cloudflare / CloudFront / EdgeOne / ESA，与自有节点一起调度。
插件市场：在主控里一键购买、下载、启用插件；开发者可以上架赚钱。
授权租约：授权端暂时不可达时，主控在租约与宽限期内照常运行。
节点升级包经主控缓存后再分发。
en: First public release and the compatibility baseline for later versions.
Node subscriptions: List nodes on the market by day, traffic or 95th percentile; combine subscribed nodes with your own and resell them.
Dynamic routing: Sites are data, not config files: add, change or remove without reloads. Designed for a million sites.
Adaptive WAF: Tunes exclusions to each site’s real traffic; the official rule library updates for free.
Automatic defense: Nodes learn a local baseline, mitigate within seconds when an attack starts and revoke when it ends.
Aggregated edge: Bring your own Cloudflare, CloudFront, EdgeOne or ESA account and schedule it alongside your nodes.
Plugin market: Buy, download and enable plugins inside the control plane; developers publish and earn.
Licence lease: the control plane keeps running through the lease and grace period if licensing is unreachable.
Node upgrade packages are cached by the control plane before distribution.

description.zh: cdnca 各平台入口与账号的区别、菜单找不到时怎么办、通用操作习惯，以及本文档的组织方式。
description.en: cdnca entry points and accounts, what to do when a menu is missing, good habits, and how these docs are organised.

body.zh:
cdnca 由几个分开的平台组成。每个平台有自己的账号和权限，用同一个邮箱或用户名注册，权限也不会自动互通。动手之前，先确认你要去哪个平台、用哪个账号。

## 先分清入口和账号 {#entries}

| 入口 | 谁使用 | 适合办理的事情 | 常见错误 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 授权中心（授权门户） | 购买或领取主控授权的客户 | 查看和续费授权、生成主控安装命令、充值、查看订单和资料 | 把授权中心当成自己的主控后台 |
| 授权运营后台 | 平台运营人员 | 管理客户与授权、实名审核、收款设置、版本发布、市场审核 | 用客户账号或主控管理员账号登录 |
| 主控管理端 | 客户主控管理员 | 节点、网站、套餐、用户、DNS、证书、安全、插件、系统设置 | 用普通用户账号去做管理员的工作 |
| 主控用户端 | 主控下的普通用户（站长） | 管理自己的网站、证书、缓存、防护、套餐和账户 | 访问管理员配置或别人的网站 |
| 卖家中心 | 节点供货商、插件开发者 | 入驻申请、收款账户、保证金、收入与结算、申诉 | 以为在卖家中心就能创建节点报价 |

几个容易混淆的地方：

- 主控管理端和主控用户端是同一台主控上的两套界面，登录地址都是自己主控的 /dashboard/login，登录后按账号身份显示不同菜单。
- 节点报价的创建、上架和购买都在自己主控的“节点市场”里办理；卖家中心只负责身份申请、收款和结算。
- 普通用户的“插件市场”只管理已经提供给本账号的插件；主控管理员在“插件商店”里选购插件。两者不是同一个页面。

## 菜单找不到时 {#missing-menu}

菜单没有显示，不一定是权限问题。按顺序确认：

1. 当前所在的平台对不对（看页面标题和地址）。
2. 当前登录的是管理员还是普通用户（看右上角账号）。
3. 这项服务是否已经开通（例如某些模块需要授权包含对应功能）。

确认后仍然缺少入口时，把缺少的菜单名称、当前账号和页面地址交给对应的管理员核对：主控里的入口找本主控管理员，授权中心和市场入口找平台。不要为了找到功能借用别人的账号。

## 本文档的组织方式

- [入门与安装](/docs/requirements)：系统要求、[主控安装](/docs/install-control)、[节点安装](/docs/install-node)。
- 主控管理：[网站、域名、证书与防护](/docs/admin-sites)、[用户、套餐与代理商](/docs/admin-users-packages)、[系统设置与日常维护](/docs/admin-system)、[重启、升级、卸载与迁移](/docs/operations)。
- 网站用户：[网站用户手册](/docs/tenant-guide)。
- 授权与门户：[授权门户](/docs/license-portal)、[授权运营后台](/docs/license-operator)。
- 节点市场：[节点供货商](/docs/market-supplier)、[节点订阅方](/docs/market-subscriber)、[节点市场问题处理](/docs/market-problems)。
- 插件：[插件安装与使用](/docs/plugins)。
- 遇到问题：[问题处理](/docs/troubleshooting)。

每篇按“有什么用、谁操作、从哪里进入、准备什么、怎么做、怎样确认成功、失败了怎么办”来写。菜单路径用“→”连接，例如“网站管理 → 网站列表”。

## 通用做法 {#common}

1. 保存后先回读：返回列表或重新打开详情，确认数据已经保存。
2. 结果不明确时先查再做：先刷新详情、查看订单或任务记录，不要连续重复创建或付款。页面提供“使用同一请求重试”时，用它继续原来的操作。
3. 记录便于定位的信息：页面名称、对象名称、操作时间、订单号或任务编号，以及页面显示的请求 ID。
4. 保护账户和资料：截图、工单和聊天里不要出现密码、验证码、API 密钥、DNS 密钥、证书私钥、完整付款信息或身份证件。
5. 找对负责人：授权和订单问题联系平台；主控资源问题联系本主控管理员；节点问题先联系直接供货方；插件问题联系主控管理员或插件提供者。

文中的域名一律是示例：主控用 console.cdnca.com，网站用 www.cdnca.com，请换成自己的域名。
body.en:
cdnca is made of several separate platforms. Each has its own accounts and permissions; signing up with the same e-mail or username does not link them. Before you start, check which platform you need and which account to use.

## Entry points and accounts {#entries}

| Entry point | Who uses it | What it is for | Common mistake |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Licence centre (portal) | Customers who buy or claim a control-plane licence | View and renew licences, generate the install command, top up, view orders and profile | Treating it as your control-plane console |
| Licensing console | Platform operators | Customers and licences, identity reviews, payment settings, releases, market reviews | Signing in with a customer or control-plane admin account |
| Control-plane admin console | Your control-plane administrator | Nodes, sites, plans, users, DNS, certificates, security, plugins, settings | Doing admin work with a regular user account |
| Control-plane user console | Regular users (site owners) on a control plane | Their own sites, certificates, cache, protection, plans and account | Opening admin settings or someone else's site |
| Seller centre | Node suppliers, plugin developers | Onboarding, payout accounts, deposit, income and settlement, disputes | Expecting to create node offers there |

Things that are easy to mix up:

- The admin console and the user console are two views of the same control plane. Both sign in at /dashboard/login on your control plane; the menu depends on the account.
- Node offers are created, published and bought in "Node market" on your own control plane. The seller centre only handles onboarding, payouts and settlement.
- A regular user's "Plugin market" manages plugins already provided to that account. Administrators buy plugins in "Plugin store". They are different pages.

## When a menu is missing {#missing-menu}

A missing menu is not always a permission problem. Check in this order:

1. You are on the right platform (page title and address).
2. You are signed in as an administrator or as a regular user (account in the top-right corner).
3. The service is enabled (some modules need a licence that includes the feature).

If the entry is still missing, send the menu name, your account and the page address to the right administrator: your control-plane administrator for control-plane menus, the platform for licence-centre and market menus. Do not borrow someone else's account.

## How these docs are organised

- [Getting started](/docs/requirements): requirements, [installing the control plane](/docs/install-control), [installing a node](/docs/install-node).
- Control-plane admin: [sites, domains, certificates and protection](/docs/admin-sites), [users, plans and resellers](/docs/admin-users-packages), [settings and daily operations](/docs/admin-system), [restart, upgrade, uninstall and migrate](/docs/operations).
- Site users: [site user guide](/docs/tenant-guide).
- Licences and portal: [licence portal](/docs/license-portal), [licensing console](/docs/license-operator).
- Node market: [node supplier](/docs/market-supplier), [node subscriber](/docs/market-subscriber), [node market problems](/docs/market-problems).
- Plugins: [installing and using plugins](/docs/plugins).
- Problems: [troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting).

Each page covers what a task is for, who does it, where to start, what to prepare, the steps, how to confirm success and what to do if it fails. Menu paths use "→", for example "Sites → Site list". Menu names are quoted as they appear in the Chinese interface where no English label exists.

## Good habits {#common}

1. Read back after saving: return to the list or reopen the details to confirm the change.
2. When a result is unclear, check before acting again: refresh the details, look at the order or task record, and do not create or pay twice. If the page offers "retry with the same request", use it to continue the original action.
3. Note what helps locate the problem: page, object, time, order or task number, and the request ID shown on the page.
4. Protect accounts and data: never put passwords, codes, API keys, DNS keys, private keys, full payment details or ID documents in screenshots, tickets or chats.
5. Ask the right person: the platform for licences and orders; your control-plane administrator for its resources; your direct supplier for nodes; your administrator or the plugin provider for plugins.

All domains are examples: console.cdnca.com for the control plane and www.cdnca.com for a site. Use your own.

description.zh: cdnca 主控与节点的系统支持矩阵、CPU、内存、磁盘要求，以及需要开放的端口。
description.en: Supported systems, CPU, memory and disk requirements for the cdnca control plane and nodes, and the ports to open.

body.zh:
主控与节点都只支持 x86_64，需要全新安装的系统。安装器会先做一遍预检：“不通过”必须处理后才能继续，“警告”可以确认后继续（或加 -y）。

| 系统 | 主控 | 节点 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ubuntu 24.04 | 正式支持 | 正式支持 |
| Ubuntu 22.04 / 20.04 | 兼容 | 兼容 |
| Debian 10 / 11 / 12 / 13 | 兼容 | 兼容（Debian 10 需 backports 内核） |
| Rocky / AlmaLinux / RHEL 8 / 9 / 10 | 兼容（10 需 x86-64-v3） | 兼容 |
| Ubuntu 18.04 | 不支持 | 兼容（需 HWE 内核） |
| Ubuntu 16.04 / Debian 9 | 不支持 | 不支持 |

## 硬件 {#hardware}

- 主控：内存最低 4G（建议 8G）；磁盘 10G 起（建议 40G 以上，SSD 100G 更佳）；CPU 需支持 SSE4.2。推荐 2 核 8G。
- 节点：内存最低 1G 且保留 2G Swap（建议 2G 内存）；磁盘 2G 起，缓存多时加大磁盘。

## 网络与端口 {#ports}

| 机器 | 需要对外开放 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 主控 | TCP 443（或安装时填的 HTTPS 端口）、TCP 80 | 管理后台；80 用于申请 HTTPS 证书 |
| 主控 | 两个网关端口（节点注册、节点通道） | 安装结束时告知，默认在 20000–29999 随机选取 |
| 节点 | TCP 80、443 及网站使用的其他端口 | 对访客提供服务 |

- 主控需要能访问授权端（auth.cdnca.com）和安装包下载源；节点需要能访问主控和网关端口。
- 节点本机还会占用 18080（健康检查）和 18443（证书服务），只在本机使用，不需要对外开放，但不能被其他程序占用。
- 记得同时检查云服务商的安全组。不要整体关闭防火墙。

## 安装前 {#before-install}

- 使用干净的系统，不要预装 Web 服务、数据库等环境。
- 主控公网 IP 要与授权里登记的授权 IP 一致。
- 用域名访问主控时，先把域名解析到主控服务器。

下一步：[主控安装](/docs/install-control)。
body.en:
Both the control plane and nodes are x86_64 only and need a fresh system. The installer runs a preflight first: “fail” must be fixed, “warn” can be confirmed (or pass -y).

| 系统 | Control plane | Node |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ubuntu 24.04 | Official | Official |
| Ubuntu 22.04 / 20.04 | Compatible | Compatible |
| Debian 10 / 11 / 12 / 13 | Compatible | Compatible (Debian 10 needs a backports kernel) |
| Rocky / AlmaLinux / RHEL 8 / 9 / 10 | Compatible (10 needs x86-64-v3) | Compatible |
| Ubuntu 18.04 | Not supported | Compatible (HWE kernel) |
| Ubuntu 16.04 / Debian 9 | Not supported | Not supported |

## Hardware {#hardware}

- Control plane: at least 4 GB RAM (8 GB recommended); 10 GB disk minimum (40 GB+, ideally 100 GB SSD); CPU with SSE4.2. 2 cores and 8 GB are recommended.
- Node: at least 1 GB RAM with 2 GB swap (2 GB RAM recommended); 2 GB disk minimum, more if you cache a lot.

## Network and ports {#ports}

| Server | Open to the internet | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Control plane | TCP 443 (or the HTTPS port you chose), TCP 80 | Console; 80 is used to issue the HTTPS certificate |
| Control plane | Two gateway ports (node enrollment, node channel) | Printed at the end of the install, chosen at random in 20000–29999 by default |
| Node | TCP 80, 443 and any other ports your sites use | Serves visitors |

- The control plane must reach the licensing service (auth.cdnca.com) and the package download source; nodes must reach the control plane and its gateway ports.
- Nodes also use 18080 (health check) and 18443 (certificate service) locally. They need not be open to the internet but must be free.
- Check your cloud provider's security group as well. Do not turn the firewall off.

## Before installing {#before-install}

- Use a clean system without web servers, databases or similar pre-installed.
- The control plane's public IP must match the licensed IP.
- To use a domain for the console, point it at the control-plane server first.

Next: [install the control plane](/docs/install-control).

description.zh: 在授权中心生成安装命令、一条命令安装 cdnca 主控、首次登录，网关端口与防火墙，以及按失败步骤处理。
description.en: Generate the command in the licence centre, install the cdnca control plane, sign in, gateway ports and firewall, and what to do for each failed step.

body.zh:
主控是你自己的 CDN 管理后台。安装由主控管理员在一台全新的服务器上完成，命令从授权中心生成。安装过程中会同时创建首个管理员，装完直接登录，不需要再做“首次初始化”。

## 准备 {#before-you-start}

- 一台全新安装系统的 x86_64 服务器和它的 root 权限，系统与配置见[系统要求](/docs/requirements)。不要预装 Web 服务、数据库等环境。
- 一份可用的主控授权，授权 IP 与这台服务器的公网 IP 一致。
- 打算用域名访问时，先把管理域名（例如 console.cdnca.com）解析到这台服务器，并确保 TCP 80 能从公网访问（用于申请 HTTPS 证书）。
- 一个能收信的邮箱，用于证书申请联系。

## 第一步：在授权中心生成安装命令 {#command}

1. 登录授权中心，打开左侧“我的授权”，点击本次使用的授权进入详情。
2. 在“授权详情”核对“授权 IP”与服务器公网 IP 一致。不一致时先回列表修改主控 IP；未登记的 IP 下载安装脚本会返回 403。
3. 在右侧“安装说明”点击“一键安装脚本”→“生成安装命令”→“复制”。命令里带一次性激活凭据，24 小时内有效，只显示这一次。

命令只用于自己的服务器，不要发给他人或贴到公开工单。授权已经装过主控时，详情页不再生成首装命令，迁移请看[迁移到新服务器](/docs/operations#migrate)。

命令的样子如下（实际以授权中心复制的为准，激活凭据由页面自动带上）：

```主控安装命令
(f=$(mktemp) || exit 1; trap 'rc=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $rc' EXIT; trap 'exit 130' INT; trap 'exit 143' TERM; { curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -fsSL -o "$f" 'https://auth.cdnca.com/downloads/install-control.sh'; } || { rc=$?; echo '[cdnca-control] error: 无法下载安装脚本' >&2; exit $rc; }; { [ "$(head -c 2 "$f")" = '#!' ] && [ "$(tail -n 1 "$f")" = 'main "$@"' ]; } || { echo '[cdnca-control] error: 下载的安装脚本为空或不完整' >&2; exit 1; }; bash "$f" --licensing-server 'https://auth.cdnca.com')
```

## 第二步：在服务器上执行 {#run}

以 root 登录服务器，粘贴整条命令执行。不需要另外拼接下载地址或激活参数。安装器会逐步显示当前步骤、整体进度和预计剩余时间，完整输出写入 /var/log/cdnca-install-control-*.log。

按提示填写：

| 提示 | 怎么填 |
| --- | --- |
| 管理端公网域名或 IP | 管理员和用户访问后台用的地址，例如 console.cdnca.com；用域名时先确认解析正确 |
| HTTPS 端口 | 默认 443；用其他端口时，之后的访问地址都要带上这个端口 |
| 证书联系邮箱 | 能收信的邮箱，用于 HTTPS 证书申请；它不是管理员登录名 |
| 管理员用户名 | 自己设置，没有通用默认账号；小写字母开头，3–128 位，可用小写字母、数字、下划线、点和连字符 |
| 管理员密码 | 自己设置，8–1024 位，至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字、符号中的两种，不能含空格或中文；输入时屏幕不显示字符，按提示再输一次 |

预检结果分两种：“不通过”是硬性条件（系统版本、架构、内存、端口占用等），必须处理后才能继续；“警告”可以确认后继续，也可以在命令末尾加 --yes 跳过确认。

也可以用参数直接给出这些值，适合批量或无人值守安装：

```
bash install-control.sh --licensing-server 'https://auth.cdnca.com' --master-host console.cdnca.com --master-port 443 --certificate-email ops@cdnca.com --admin-username admin --admin-email ops@cdnca.com
```

已有可信的公网证书时，用 --public-cert-file 和 --public-key-file 指定证书与私钥文件，安装器就不再申请证书。

## 第三步：确认安装完成并登录 {#login}

1. 等终端出现 control-api installed, activated and ready。只看到下载完成或解压完成时不要关闭终端。
2. 在浏览器打开 https://console.cdnca.com/dashboard/login。端口不是 443 时写成 https://console.cdnca.com:端口/dashboard/login。终端里打印的 Control plane URL 不带端口，以你填的端口为准。
3. 用刚设置的管理员用户名和密码登录，检查右上角账号、授权状态和到期时间。

也可以在服务器上确认服务状态，四项都应为 active：

```
systemctl is-active cdnca-control-api cdnca-agent-gateway cdnca-control-nats cdnca-control-web
```

回到授权中心的授权详情，“授权 IP”“授权域名”应显示这台主控上报的值。

## 网关端口、防火墙与证书 {#ports}

- 安装结束时会告知两个网关端口（节点注册、节点通道）。不指定时在 20000–29999 随机选两个空闲端口，也可以用 --gateway-ports 注册,通道 指定。不要照抄旧教程里的固定端口。
- 在主机防火墙和云安全组放行 TCP 443、80 以及这两个网关端口。不要整体关闭防火墙。
- 用域名安装时，证书申请需要域名解析正确且 TCP 80 可从公网访问。
- 直接用 IP 安装时，主控使用本机私有 CA 证书，浏览器会提示不受信任；先核对服务器地址无误再继续。
- 管理后台前面套 CDN 时，CDN 对外 443，回源端口填管理端 HTTPS 端口（默认 443，即安装时 --master-port 填的端口）。节点经 CDN 连网关时另行配置，回源端口填网关注册端口，按安装结束时的提示或“网关管理”页操作。

## 安装失败时 {#failed}

命令返回安装器自己的退出码；下载失败、下载内容为空或不完整时，不会执行任何安装步骤。终端最后会标出失败的步骤（“✗ [第几步/共几步] … 失败”）、版本和日志位置，上方的 error 行是原因。完整输出（含失败子命令的输出）在 /var/log/cdnca-install-control-*.log。按失败的步骤处理：

| 失败在哪一步 | 本机状态 | 怎么处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 第 1–4 步：环境预检、基础工具、激活凭据与管理员、下载并校验安装包 | 还没写入主控状态，激活凭据未使用 | 按 error 行处理（登记出口 IP、放行端口、换可用的下载源等），然后重新执行同一条命令；凭据过期就回授权中心重新生成 |
| 第 5–8 步：安装依赖、生成身份与证书、下载节点组件、初始化数据库 | 已写入部分状态 | 按 error 行修复后重新执行同一条命令。安装器提示 existing control installation state 或 existing_state_requires_review 时，不要手工删目录凑成“全新”，把日志与失败步骤交技术支持，或换一台干净的服务器 |
| 第 9 步（激活授权）及以后 | 授权端可能已记录本次安装 | 不要重复全新安装；保留日志，按 error 行和日志里对应的“>>> …（失败输出）”段排查。要换服务器，整机迁移见[迁移到新服务器](/docs/operations#migrate)；全新重装需联系授权运营办理（修改主控 IP 不会解除旧主控的绑定） |

常见原因：

- 下载返回 403：授权 IP 与服务器出口 IP 不一致，在授权中心改成正确的 IP 后重试。
- 激活凭据过期：回授权详情重新生成安装命令。
- 域名打不开：核对解析、公网 IP、实际端口和云安全组；修改 DNS 后等待生效。
- 密码输入时没有字符：这是隐藏输入，输完回车，再按提示确认。
- 装完不能登录：核对用户名、完整访问地址（含端口）和服务状态。忘记密码见[问题处理](/docs/troubleshooting#forgot-password)。

更多排查见[问题处理](/docs/troubleshooting)。下一步：[安装节点](/docs/install-node)。
body.en:
The control plane is your own CDN console. Your administrator installs it on a fresh server with a command generated in the licence centre. The installer also creates the first administrator, so you sign in straight after; there is no separate first-run setup.

## Before you start {#before-you-start}

- A freshly installed x86_64 server with root access; see [requirements](/docs/requirements). Do not pre-install web servers, databases or similar.
- A valid control-plane licence whose licensed IP matches the server's public IP.
- To use a domain, point the console domain (for example console.cdnca.com) at the server first and keep TCP 80 reachable from the internet (needed to issue the HTTPS certificate).
- An e-mail address that receives mail, used as the certificate contact.

## Step 1: generate the install command {#command}

1. Sign in to the licence centre, open "My licences" and click the licence you will use.
2. In the licence details, check that the licensed IP matches the server's public IP. If not, change the control-plane IP in the list first; an unregistered IP gets 403 when downloading the installer.
3. Under the install instructions, click "One-click install script" → "Generate install command" → "Copy". The command carries a one-time activation credential, valid for 24 hours and shown only once.

Use the command only on your own server; do not share it or paste it in public tickets. Once a licence has a control plane installed, the details page no longer generates a first-install command; to move servers see [migrate to a new server](/docs/operations#migrate).

The command looks like this (always use the one copied from the licence centre; it adds the credential for you):

```Control-plane install command
(f=$(mktemp) || exit 1; trap 'rc=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $rc' EXIT; trap 'exit 130' INT; trap 'exit 143' TERM; { curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -fsSL -o "$f" 'https://auth.cdnca.com/downloads/install-control.sh'; } || { rc=$?; echo '[cdnca-control] error: 无法下载安装脚本' >&2; exit $rc; }; { [ "$(head -c 2 "$f")" = '#!' ] && [ "$(tail -n 1 "$f")" = 'main "$@"' ]; } || { echo '[cdnca-control] error: 下载的安装脚本为空或不完整' >&2; exit 1; }; bash "$f" --licensing-server 'https://auth.cdnca.com')
```

## Step 2: run it on the server {#run}

Sign in as root and paste the whole command. Do not add download URLs or activation flags yourself. The installer shows each step, overall progress and the estimated time left; the full output goes to /var/log/cdnca-install-control-*.log.

Answer the prompts:

| Prompt | What to enter |
| --- | --- |
| Console public domain or IP | The address admins and users open, for example console.cdnca.com; check DNS first when using a domain |
| HTTPS port | 443 by default; with another port, every console address must include it |
| Certificate contact e-mail | A working mailbox for HTTPS certificate requests; it is not the admin login |
| Admin username | Your choice, there is no default account; starts with a lowercase letter, 3–128 characters of lowercase letters, digits, underscore, dot and hyphen |
| Admin password | Your choice, 8–1024 characters with at least two of upper case, lower case, digits and symbols, no spaces or non-ASCII characters; nothing is echoed while typing, enter it twice |

The preflight reports two kinds of result: "failed" items (OS version, architecture, memory, ports in use and so on) must be fixed before you continue; "warning" items can be confirmed, or skipped with --yes at the end of the command.

You can also pass the values as flags for scripted installs:

```
bash install-control.sh --licensing-server 'https://auth.cdnca.com' --master-host console.cdnca.com --master-port 443 --certificate-email ops@cdnca.com --admin-username admin --admin-email ops@cdnca.com
```

If you already have a trusted public certificate, pass it with --public-cert-file and --public-key-file and the installer will not request one.

## Step 3: confirm and sign in {#login}

1. Wait for control-api installed, activated and ready in the terminal. Do not close it after "download complete" or "unpacked".
2. Open https://console.cdnca.com/dashboard/login. With a port other than 443 use https://console.cdnca.com:PORT/dashboard/login. The "Control plane URL" printed in the terminal omits the port; use the port you entered.
3. Sign in with the admin username and password you set and check the account, licence status and expiry.

On the server, all four services should be active:

```
systemctl is-active cdnca-control-api cdnca-agent-gateway cdnca-control-nats cdnca-control-web
```

In the licence centre, the licence details should now show the licensed IP and domain reported by this control plane.

## Gateway ports, firewall and certificates {#ports}

- The installer prints two gateway ports at the end (node enrollment and node channel). By default it picks two free ports in 20000–29999; set them with --gateway-ports enrollment,channel if needed. Do not copy fixed ports from old guides.
- Open TCP 443, 80 and both gateway ports in the host firewall and the cloud security group. Do not turn the firewall off.
- With a domain, issuing the certificate needs correct DNS and TCP 80 reachable from the internet.
- With an IP only, the control plane uses a private local CA and browsers warn that it is untrusted; check the server address before continuing.
- To put the console behind a CDN, keep 443 public and set the origin port to the management HTTPS port (443 by default, or the --master-port value). Nodes that reach the gateway through a CDN are set up separately: the origin port is the gateway enrollment port; follow the installer's closing notes or the Gateways page.

## If the install fails {#failed}

The command returns the installer's own exit code; a failed, empty or truncated download runs no install step. The last lines mark the failed step ("✗ [step/total] … 失败"), the version and the log; the error line above is the cause. The full output, including the failed sub-command's output, is in /var/log/cdnca-install-control-*.log. Act on the failed step:

| Failed step | State on the host | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Steps 1–4: preflight, base tools, activation credential and admin, download and verify | No control-plane state written; credential unused | Fix what the error line says (register the egress IP, open ports, use a reachable download source) and run the same command again; generate a new command if the credential expired |
| Steps 5–8: dependencies, identity and certificates, node components, database | Some state written | Fix the cause and run the same command again. If the installer reports existing control installation state or existing_state_requires_review, do not delete directories to make the host look fresh; send the log and failed step to support, or use a clean server |
| Step 9 (activate) and later | The licence server may have recorded this installation | Do not rerun the fresh install; keep the log and follow the error line and the matching ">>> …（失败输出）" section. To move servers, see [migrate to a new server](/docs/operations#migrate) for a whole-server move; a fresh reinstall goes through the licensing operator (changing the master IP does not release the old control plane) |

Common causes:

- 403 on download: the licensed IP is not the server's egress IP; correct it in the licence centre and retry.
- Credential expired: generate a new install command in the licence details.
- Domain does not open: check DNS, public IP, the actual port and the security group; wait for DNS changes to apply.
- No characters while typing the password: input is hidden; press Enter and confirm.
- Cannot sign in after install: check the username, the full address including the port, and service status. For a lost password see [troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting#forgot-password).

More in [troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting). Next: [install a node](/docs/install-node).

body.zh:
节点是真正为网站提供加速和防护的服务器。主控管理员在主控里复制一条安装命令，到节点服务器上执行；节点会自动注册到主控，再由管理员初始化、加入线路分组后开始服务。

## 准备 {#before-you-start}

- 已能登录的主控，以及剩余的节点授权额度。
- 一台全新安装系统的 x86_64 节点服务器和它的 root 权限，配置见[系统要求](/docs/requirements)。
- 先想好这台节点归属哪个区域。稍后节点和线路分组要选同一个区域，否则在线路分组里看不到这台节点的 IP。

## 第一步：复制安装命令 {#command}

1. 用管理员账号进入“节点管理 → 节点列表”。打算用命名区域时，先点“区域管理”新增区域。
2. 点“安装节点”，选择“复制命令安装”，再点“复制安装命令”。

同一台主控的所有节点用同一条命令，不需要先手动添加节点，也不需要填写节点编号。复制命令本身不会创建节点。命令里带注册凭据（只经标准输入传递，不出现在进程参数里），不要公开；如已泄露，点“重置注册凭据”，之前复制的命令全部失效，已安装的节点不受影响。“SSH 远程安装”是另一种入口，第一次接入用复制命令即可。

命令的样子如下（实际以主控页面复制的为准）：

```节点安装命令
(f=$(mktemp) || exit 1; trap 'rc=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $rc' EXIT; trap 'exit 130' INT; trap 'exit 143' TERM; { curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -fsSL -o "$f" 'https://console.cdnca.com/downloads/install-node.sh'; } || { rc=$?; echo '[cdnca-edge] error: 无法下载安装脚本' >&2; exit $rc; }; { [ "$(head -c 2 "$f")" = '#!' ] && [ "$(tail -n 1 "$f")" = 'main "$@"' ]; } || { echo '[cdnca-edge] error: 下载的安装脚本为空或不完整' >&2; exit 1; }; printf '%s\n' '<注册密钥>' | bash "$f" --control-plane 'https://console.cdnca.com' --registration-key-stdin)
```

## 第二步：在节点服务器上执行 {#run}

以 root 登录节点服务器，粘贴整条命令执行。安装器会逐步显示当前步骤、整体进度与预计剩余时间，完整输出写入 /var/log/cdnca-install-node-*.log。最后一行 `install-state:` 是结论：`install-state: serving` 表示安装完成、节点已对外服务；全新节点还没初始化，安装器不等待凭据，直接显示 `install-state: installed_pending_initialization` 并以退出码 3 结束，表示已安装、待初始化，不是安装失败，完成第三步初始化后节点自动开放；已初始化的节点 180 秒内没收到首张授权签名凭据时显示 `install-state: installed_pending_ticket`（已安装、待首票）。

常用参数（加在复制的命令末尾的右括号之前）：

| 参数 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| --yes | 预检只有“警告”时不再询问，直接继续 |
| --public-ip IP | 指定本机公网 IP（默认自动探测） |
| --no-external-probe | 不参与外部节点探测 |
| --skip-firewall | 不修改本机防火墙 |
| --disable-xdp | 不挂载 XDP 内核过滤（只用 nftables） |

```
(f=$(mktemp) || exit 1; trap 'rc=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $rc' EXIT; trap 'exit 130' INT; trap 'exit 143' TERM; { curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -fsSL -o "$f" 'https://console.cdnca.com/downloads/install-node.sh'; } || { rc=$?; echo '[cdnca-edge] error: 无法下载安装脚本' >&2; exit $rc; }; { [ "$(head -c 2 "$f")" = '#!' ] && [ "$(tail -n 1 "$f")" = 'main "$@"' ]; } || { echo '[cdnca-edge] error: 下载的安装脚本为空或不完整' >&2; exit 1; }; printf '%s\n' '<注册密钥>' | bash "$f" --control-plane 'https://console.cdnca.com' --registration-key-stdin --yes --public-ip 203.0.113.10)
```

## 第三步：初始化节点 {#initialize}

1. 回到“节点管理 → 节点列表”，打开“待初始化”，按 IP 和添加时间找到新节点。
2. 点该节点的“初始化”。确认框里有“区域”时选择准备使用的区域（只有一个区域时会自动选中），点“确定”。
3. 节点转为“正常”后，检查在线状态和最近心跳是否在更新。

初始化前，节点不下发任何站点或系统配置，也不加入 DNS 解析。页面提示节点证书 24 小时内有效，请在此期间完成初始化。只在服务器上装完、不做初始化，节点不会开始服务。

## 第四步：加入线路分组 {#line-group}

1. 打开“节点管理 → 线路分组”，点“新增分组”。
2. “区域”选择与节点相同的区域，填写名称。解析值可以留空自动生成，备注可以留空，排序保留 100 即可，点“确定”。
3. 在新分组这一行点“配置解析”。在左侧可添加的 IP 列表里勾选节点 IP，点“批量添加”→“确定”。
4. 核对右侧已配置的 IP 列表里出现了这个 IP，且为启用状态。需要备用 IP 时用“批量备用”；第一次接入先配主 IP。

只有已初始化、有可用 IP、且与分组同区域的节点，才会出现在可添加列表里。

## 怎样确认节点可用 {#verify}

- 节点列表里 IP 正确，状态“正常”，心跳持续更新。
- 线路分组里有这台节点的 IP。
- 网站接入时选到这条线路，配置发布完成后，用自己的测试网站实际访问成功（见[添加网站](/docs/admin-sites#add-site)）。

在节点服务器上也可以检查。节点上没有单独的 OpenResty 服务，OpenResty 由 cdnca-edge-agent 在收到首个发布后拉起；第二条返回 204 表示 OpenResty 在运行：

```
systemctl is-active cdnca-edge-agent
curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:18080/healthz
```

## 遇到问题 {#problems}

| 现象 | 先检查什么 |
| --- | --- |
| 安装命令失败 | 终端最后标出的失败步骤和上方的 error 行；完整输出在 /var/log/cdnca-install-node-*.log。按 error 行修复后重新执行同一条命令 |
| 节点没出现在“待初始化” | 命令是否来自本主控；安装是否报错；节点授权额度是否用完；节点到主控的网络与网关端口是否放行 |
| 一直停在“待初始化” | 是否已点“初始化”；仅在服务器上安装不能代替这一步 |
| 线路分组里没有可添加的 IP | 节点是否已初始化、有可用 IP，节点区域是否与分组区域一致 |
| 节点正常但网站打不开 | 继续检查网站选择的线路、配置发布结果、域名解析、源站和证书；不要只看节点在线标签 |
| 想重装这台节点 | 同一台机器已注册时安装器会拒绝重复注册。先在主控处理原节点，再重新执行；“重置注册凭据”不是重装按钮 |

卸载节点见[重启、升级、卸载与迁移](/docs/operations#uninstall-node)。更多排查见[问题处理](/docs/troubleshooting#node-gateway)。
body.en:
Nodes are the servers that actually accelerate and protect sites. The administrator copies an install command in the control plane and runs it on the node; the node registers itself, and the administrator then initialises it and adds it to a line group.

## Before you start {#before-you-start}

- A control plane you can sign in to, with node licence quota left.
- A freshly installed x86_64 node server with root access; see [requirements](/docs/requirements).
- Decide the node's region. The node and its line group must use the same region, otherwise the node's IP does not appear in the line group.

## Step 1: copy the install command {#command}

1. As an administrator, open "Nodes → Node list". If you use named regions, add them first under "Region management".
2. Click "Install node", choose "Install by command" and click "Copy install command".

All nodes of a control plane use the same command; you do not add the node or fill in an ID first, and copying the command does not create a node. The command carries the registration key (passed on stdin, never as an argument); keep it private. If it leaks, click "Reset registration key": every command copied before stops working, installed nodes are not affected. "SSH remote install" is a separate option; the command is enough for your first node.

The command looks like this (always use the one copied from the console):

```Node install command
(f=$(mktemp) || exit 1; trap 'rc=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $rc' EXIT; trap 'exit 130' INT; trap 'exit 143' TERM; { curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -fsSL -o "$f" 'https://console.cdnca.com/downloads/install-node.sh'; } || { rc=$?; echo '[cdnca-edge] error: 无法下载安装脚本' >&2; exit $rc; }; { [ "$(head -c 2 "$f")" = '#!' ] && [ "$(tail -n 1 "$f")" = 'main "$@"' ]; } || { echo '[cdnca-edge] error: 下载的安装脚本为空或不完整' >&2; exit 1; }; printf '%s\n' '<注册密钥>' | bash "$f" --control-plane 'https://console.cdnca.com' --registration-key-stdin)
```

## Step 2: run it on the node {#run}

Sign in as root and paste the whole command. The installer shows each step, overall progress and the estimated time left; the full output goes to /var/log/cdnca-install-node-*.log. The last `install-state:` line is the result: `install-state: serving` means the install is done and the node serves traffic. A new node that is not initialised yet ends at once with `install-state: installed_pending_initialization` and exit code 3: it is installed and waits for initialisation, not a failure, and opens by itself after step 3. An initialised node that gets no first licence ticket within 180 seconds shows `install-state: installed_pending_ticket` (installed, awaiting the first ticket).

Common flags (add them before the closing parenthesis of the copied command):

| Flag | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| --yes | Continue when the preflight only warns |
| --public-ip IP | Set the public IP (detected by default) |
| --no-external-probe | Do not take part in external probing |
| --skip-firewall | Leave the host firewall alone |
| --disable-xdp | Do not attach the XDP filter (nftables only) |

```
(f=$(mktemp) || exit 1; trap 'rc=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $rc' EXIT; trap 'exit 130' INT; trap 'exit 143' TERM; { curl --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' -fsSL -o "$f" 'https://console.cdnca.com/downloads/install-node.sh'; } || { rc=$?; echo '[cdnca-edge] error: 无法下载安装脚本' >&2; exit $rc; }; { [ "$(head -c 2 "$f")" = '#!' ] && [ "$(tail -n 1 "$f")" = 'main "$@"' ]; } || { echo '[cdnca-edge] error: 下载的安装脚本为空或不完整' >&2; exit 1; }; printf '%s\n' '<注册密钥>' | bash "$f" --control-plane 'https://console.cdnca.com' --registration-key-stdin --yes --public-ip 203.0.113.10)
```

## Step 3: initialise the node {#initialize}

1. Back in "Nodes → Node list", open "Pending initialisation" and find the new node by IP and time added.
2. Click "Initialise". If the dialog shows "Region", choose the region you planned (a single region is preselected) and click "OK".
3. When the node turns "Normal", check that it is online and its last heartbeat keeps updating.

Before initialisation the node receives no site or system configuration and is not added to DNS. The page notes that the node certificate is valid for 24 hours, so initialise within that time. Installing on the server alone does not put the node into service.

## Step 4: add it to a line group {#line-group}

1. Open "Nodes → Line groups" and click "Add group".
2. Choose the same "Region" as the node and enter a name. The resolution value can be left empty to generate one, the note can be empty and the order can stay 100. Click "OK".
3. On the new group's row click "Set resolution". Tick the node IP in the list on the left, click "Add in batch" → "OK".
4. Check that the IP appears, enabled, in the configured list on the right. Use "Set standby in batch" for standby IPs; start with a primary IP.

Only initialised nodes with a usable IP in the same region as the group appear in the list.

## Check the node works {#verify}

- The node list shows the right IP, status "Normal" and a fresh heartbeat.
- The line group lists the node's IP.
- A test site using this line opens correctly after its configuration is published (see [add a site](/docs/admin-sites#add-site)).

On the node itself: there is no separate OpenResty service; cdnca-edge-agent starts OpenResty once the first release arrives. 204 from the second command means OpenResty is running:

```
systemctl is-active cdnca-edge-agent
curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:18080/healthz
```

## Problems {#problems}

| What you see | Check first |
| --- | --- |
| The install command fails | The failed step marked at the end and the error line above it; full output in /var/log/cdnca-install-node-*.log. Fix the cause and run the same command again |
| The node does not appear under "Pending initialisation" | The command came from this control plane; the installer reported no error; node quota is left; the node can reach the control plane and its gateway ports |
| It stays pending | You clicked "Initialise"; installing on the server does not replace this step |
| No IP to add in the line group | The node is initialised and has a usable IP, and its region matches the group |
| Node is normal but the site does not open | The site's line, publish result, DNS, origin and certificate; the online badge alone is not enough |
| You want to reinstall the node | The installer refuses to register a machine twice. Handle the old node in the console first; "Reset registration key" is not a reinstall |

To uninstall a node see [operations](/docs/operations#uninstall-node). More in [troubleshooting](/docs/troubleshooting#node-gateway).

description.zh: 主控管理员配置 DNS 与 CNAME 域名、添加网站、域名接入、HTTPS 证书、防护和配置发布。
description.en: For administrators: DNS and CNAME domains, adding sites, pointing domains, HTTPS certificates, protection and publishing.

body.zh:
本篇面向客户主控管理员：把网站接入平台、让域名指向平台、配置 HTTPS 证书和防护。普通用户管理自己的网站见[网站用户手册](/docs/tenant-guide)。

## 准备 {#before-you-start}

- 已登录主控管理端，至少有一台已初始化并加入线路分组的节点（见[节点安装](/docs/install-node)）。
- 已在“节点管理 → DNS配置”配置好 DNS 服务商和 CNAME 域名（见[配置 DNS 与 CNAME 域名](#dns)）。没有这一步，新网站拿不到 CNAME。
- 网站所属用户已有可用套餐（见[用户、套餐与代理商](/docs/admin-users-packages)）。
- 准备好网站域名和源站地址。

## 配置 DNS 与 CNAME 域名 {#dns}

这是整个主控只需配置一次的设置，不需要每个网站用户重复办理。

1. 打开“节点管理 → DNS配置”，在“DNS配置”页签选择 DNS 提供商（阿里云、华为云、DNSLA、DNSPod、帝恩思、Cloudflare、Name.com 等），填写授权资料后保存。密钥保存后不回显，不修改时留空。
2. 切到“CNAME域名”页签，添加用于给网站分配 CNAME 的域名。
3. 保存后重新打开页面，确认服务商与 CNAME 域名都在。

不要在截图或工单里发送 DNS 密钥。保存失败时核对服务商类型、密钥权限范围和该域名是否在这个账号下。

## 添加网站 {#add-site}

1. 打开“网站管理 → 网站列表”，点“添加网站”。第一次使用选“单个”页签，熟悉后再用“批量”。
2. 按表单填写：

| 字段 | 怎么填 |
| --- | --- |
| 所属用户 | 按 ID、邮箱、用户名或手机号搜索并选择网站归属的用户 |
| 用户套餐 | 选择该用户名下的有效套餐；显示“该用户暂无可用套餐”时先给用户开通套餐 |
| 所属分组 | 网站分组，可不选 |
| 网站域名 | 例如 www.cdnca.com；多个域名用逗号或换行分隔，中文域名会自动转为 Punycode |
| 源站地址 | 每行一个 IP、IP:端口、域名或域名:端口，最多 32 个 |
| 回源协议 | HTTP、HTTPS 或“跟随访问协议” |
| 回源 Host | 可留空，留空时使用访客访问的域名；建站后可在“回源设置”里修改 |

3. 默认 HTTP 监听 80 端口，HTTPS 暂不开启；证书准备好后再开（见[配置 HTTPS](#https)）。点“创建网站”。
4. 回到网站列表按域名搜索，确认网站已创建，并查看“CNAME”列。

CNAME 写入 DNS 服务商、并从服务商查回同样的记录后，列表就显示 CNAME 值，旁边有复制按钮；还在写入时显示“生成中”，页面会自动刷新。显示 CNAME 后即可去改解析，何时全网生效由 DNS 服务商决定，平台不另外等待确认。

显示“生成失败”时，点它查看原因，例如“未配置默认 CNAME 区，请到 节点管理 → DNS配置 → CNAME域名 配置”。弹窗里可以直接点“去 DNS 配置”，处理好后点“重新生成”。

批量添加时，每行一个网站，格式为 domain=www.cdnca.com,cdnca.com|ip=192.0.2.10，最多 100 行。勾选“忽略错误”时某条出错不会中断。完成后按提示核对成功与失败条数；有“结果待确认”的条目时，用“使用同一请求重试”，不要重新粘贴提交，避免重复创建。

## 让域名指向平台 {#domain}

1. 在网站列表复制该网站的 CNAME 值。
2. 登录管理该域名的 DNS 服务商，选择正确的域名，新增或修改记录。
3. 记录类型选 CNAME。例如网站域名是 www.cdnca.com，主机记录填 www，记录值填刚复制的完整 CNAME。不要填源站 IP，也不要照抄别的网站的 CNAME。
4. 保存记录，等待 DNS 更新后访问网站。

怎样确认：查询网站域名能解析到平台分配的 CNAME，访问进入预期网站。HTTPS 和节点发布结果要分别确认。解析不对时，检查是否选错域名、主机记录和同名记录冲突；刚修改的记录要等过 TTL 再查。

网站的 CNAME 跟随网站套餐，不能在网站上单独修改。到“套餐管理 → 基础套餐”改套餐的 CNAME 域名并保存后，该套餐下的网站会自动重新生成 CNAME，页面显示同步进度和跳过的原因。

## 配置 HTTPS 证书 {#https}

先在“网站管理 → 证书管理”准备证书，再到网站里启用。

申请证书：

1. 确认网站域名已经解析到平台。
2. 打开“证书管理”的“自动申请”页签，点“申请证书”，填写域名并选择验证方式：HTTP-01（文件验证，需要域名已指向平台）或 DNS-01（需要选择已配置的 DNS API）。点“提交申请”。
3. 在列表查看状态从“验证中”“签发中”变为“已签发”“已生效”，并核对域名、自动续期和到期时间。失败时“失败原因”列会说明原因。

上传已有证书：在“证书资产”页签点“上传证书”，上传后点“激活版本”。

给网站启用：

1. 打开“网站管理 → 网站列表”，进入目标网站，切到“HTTPS设置”。
2. 打开“HTTPS访问”，确认“HTTPS监听端口”（例如 443）。需要 HTTP 自动跳转时再打开“强制HTTPS”。
3. 在“证书”里选择覆盖网站全部域名的有效证书，点“应用证书”。页面提示“证书已绑定，发布任务已进入控制面队列”。
4. 从外部浏览器访问 https://www.cdnca.com，确认证书有效。

证书快到期时，先确认自动续期是否开启、续期是否失败；旧证书仍有效时不要先解绑，先解决续期验证并确认新证书生效。不要通过公开渠道传递证书私钥。

## 修改网站设置 {#edit-site}

网站详情按页签组织：基本配置、回源设置、HTTPS设置、安全设置、缓存设置、CC防护、WAF防护、访问控制、高级设置。

改源站时注意：在源站弹窗点“确认”只更新页面上的草稿，回到网站编辑页核对源站列表后，还要点页面顶部的“保存更改”才会真正提交。保存后重新打开网站，确认地址和发布结果。页面提示“结果待确认”时，点“加载最新配置”核对，不要重复修改。

## 设置防护 {#security}

- 网站级防护在网站详情的“CC防护”“WAF防护”“访问控制”页签里开关和选择规则。
- 规则本身在“网站管理”下的“CC规则”“WAF规则”“规则包”里维护；“智能自动防御”“封禁名单”“IP 名单”也在这里。
- 改动后在“统计分析 → 拉黑日志”“WAF日志”“拦截事件明细”里确认请求是否被规则处理。

正常请求被拦截时，先按日志找到命中的规则，只调整这条规则或为它加精确例外，再重新测试正常请求。不要直接关闭整站防护或放行宽泛网段。

## 配置发布与后台任务 {#publish}

网站、证书、规则的改动会生成发布任务下发到节点。长时间没有生效时：

1. 打开“系统管理 → 后台任务”，按对象和时间查看任务进度与结果。
2. 失败时记录对象名称和任务时间，回到对应页面确认最新状态，按失败原因处理。
3. 不确定是否成功时先查任务和对象详情，不要重复提交同一操作。

## 刷新缓存 {#cache}

“网站管理 → 刷新预热”可以刷新 URL、刷新目录或预热。操作步骤与网站用户相同，见[网站用户手册：刷新与预热](/docs/tenant-guide#cache)。管理员提交时可以指定目标租户。
body.en:
For control-plane administrators: putting sites on the platform, pointing domains at it, HTTPS certificates and protection. Regular users managing their own sites should read the [site user guide](/docs/tenant-guide).

## Before you start {#before-you-start}

- You are signed in to the admin console and have at least one initialised node in a line group (see [install a node](/docs/install-node)).
- A DNS provider and CNAME domain are set under "Nodes → DNS configuration" (see [DNS and CNAME domains](#dns)). Without them new sites get no CNAME.
- The site's owner has an active plan (see [users, plans and resellers](/docs/admin-users-packages)).
- You have the site's domain and origin address.

## DNS and CNAME domains {#dns}

This is set once for the whole control plane; site users do not repeat it.

1. Open "Nodes → DNS configuration". On the "DNS configuration" tab choose the provider (Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud, DNSLA, DNSPod, 51dns, Cloudflare, Name.com and others), enter its credentials and save. Saved secrets are never shown again; leave them empty to keep them.
2. On the "CNAME domains" tab add the domain used to allocate site CNAMEs.
3. Reopen the page and check both are listed.

Never send DNS keys in screenshots or tickets. If saving fails, check the provider type, the key's permissions and that the domain belongs to that account.

## Add a site {#add-site}

1. Open "Sites → Site list" and click "Add site". Use the "Single" tab first; use "Batch" once you are familiar with it.
2. Fill in the form:

| Field | What to enter |
| --- | --- |
| Owner | Search by ID, e-mail, username or phone and choose the user who owns the site |
| User plan | An active plan of that user; if it says the user has no plan, give them one first |
| Group | Optional site group |
| Site domains | For example www.cdnca.com; separate several with commas or new lines; IDNs are converted to Punycode |
| Origin addresses | One IP, IP:port, domain or domain:port per line, up to 32 |
| Origin protocol | HTTP, HTTPS or follow the visitor's protocol |
| Origin Host | Optional; empty uses the visitor's host. You can change it later under the origin settings |

3. HTTP listens on 80 by default and HTTPS is off; turn it on once the certificate is ready (see [HTTPS](#https)). Click "Create site".
4. Search the list for the domain and check the "CNAME" column.

Once the CNAME has been written to the DNS provider and read back from it, the list shows the value with a copy button; while it is being written it shows "Generating" and the page refreshes by itself. You can update DNS as soon as the CNAME is shown; global propagation is up to the DNS provider and the platform does not wait for it.

If it shows "Generation failed", click it for the reason, for example that no default CNAME zone is configured. The dialog offers "Go to DNS configuration"; after fixing the cause click "Regenerate".

For batch adds, put one site per line as domain=www.cdnca.com,cdnca.com|ip=192.0.2.10, up to 100 lines. "Ignore errors" keeps going when one line fails. Check the success and failure counts afterwards; for entries marked "result pending", use "retry with the same request" rather than pasting again, so nothing is created twice.

## Point the domain at the platform {#domain}

1. Copy the site's CNAME from the site list.
2. Sign in to the DNS provider that manages the domain and add or edit a record.
3. Choose type CNAME. For www.cdnca.com the host is www and the value is the full CNAME you copied. Do not use the origin IP or another site's CNAME.
4. Save, wait for DNS to update, then open the site.

To confirm: the domain resolves to the platform CNAME and the site opens. Check HTTPS and the node publish result separately. If resolution is wrong, check the domain, host and conflicting records with the same name; wait for the TTL after a change.

A site's CNAME follows its plan and cannot be changed on the site. Change the CNAME domain under "Plans → Base plans"; when saved, the plan's sites regenerate their CNAMEs and the page shows progress and any skipped items with reasons.

## HTTPS certificates {#https}

Prepare the certificate under "Sites → Certificates", then enable it on the site.

Request a certificate:

1. Make sure the domain already points at the platform.
2. On the "Automatic" tab of the certificates page click "Request certificate", enter the domains and choose HTTP-01 (file validation, the domain must point at the platform) or DNS-01 (choose a configured DNS API). Submit.
3. Watch the status move from validating and issuing to issued and active; check domains, auto-renewal and expiry. The failure column explains any failure.

Upload an existing certificate: on the "Certificate assets" tab click "Upload certificate", then "Activate version".

Enable it on the site:

1. Open "Sites → Site list", open the site and go to "HTTPS settings".
2. Turn on "HTTPS access" and check the HTTPS ports (for example 443). Turn on "Force HTTPS" if HTTP should redirect.
3. Under "Certificate" choose a valid certificate covering all the site's domains and click "Apply certificate". The page confirms the certificate is bound and the publish task is queued.
4. Open https://www.cdnca.com in a browser and check the certificate.

When a certificate is about to expire, check whether auto-renewal is on and whether renewal failed. Do not unbind a still-valid certificate first; fix renewal and confirm the new one is active. Never send private keys through public channels.

## Edit a site {#edit-site}

The site page has tabs: basic, origin, HTTPS, security, cache, CC protection, WAF protection, access control and advanced.

When changing origins, "Confirm" in the origin dialog only updates the draft on the page. Check the origin list, then click "Save changes" at the top of the page to submit. Reopen the site and check the address and publish result. If the page shows "result pending", click "Load latest configuration" to check before editing again.

## Protection {#security}

- Turn site protection on and pick rules on the site's "CC protection", "WAF protection" and "Access control" tabs.
- Rules themselves live under "Sites": "CC rules", "WAF rules" and "Rule packs", along with smart auto-defence, the ban list and IP lists.
- After a change, check "Analytics → Block log", "WAF log" and "Block events" to see whether requests were handled as expected.

If legitimate requests are blocked, find the matching rule in the logs, change only that rule or add a narrow exception, and test again. Do not turn off all protection or allow broad networks.

## Publishing and background tasks {#publish}

Site, certificate and rule changes create publish tasks for the nodes. If a change does not take effect:

1. Open "System → Background tasks" and check the task's progress and result.
2. On failure, note the object and time, go back to its page for the latest state and act on the reason.
3. If unsure whether it worked, check the task and object first; do not submit the same change again.

## Purge cache {#cache}

"Sites → Purge and prewarm" refreshes URLs, directories or prewarms content. The steps are the same as for site users: see [purge and prewarm](/docs/tenant-guide#cache). Administrators can also pick the target tenant.

description.zh: 主控管理员添加用户、配置套餐、开通代理商与线路组授权，以及充值、调账和订单。
description.en: For administrators: users, plans, resellers and line-group grants, top-ups, adjustments and orders.

body.zh:
本篇面向客户主控管理员：给主控添加用户、配置套餐、开通代理商，以及处理充值和订单。

## 添加或调整用户 {#users}

1. 打开“系统管理 → 用户列表”，点“新增用户”，填写用户名、邮箱等资料并保存；已有用户用“用户名、显示名称、邮箱或手机号”搜索。
2. 打开用户的“编辑”，在“基础信息”“实名信息”“登录安全”页签核对资料、用户分组和到期处理方式。
3. 只给用户完成工作需要的权限，不要给普通用户管理员权限。
4. 保存后请用户重新登录，确认只能看到自己的资源。

需要以用户身份排查问题时，在用户列表点“切换”进入该用户的用户端，结束后点“退出代登录”。用户自己的成员与子账号由其在“账户中心 → 成员与子账号”管理。

## 配置套餐 {#packages}

套餐决定用户能用多少资源、能用哪些功能、走哪条线路以及网站的 CNAME。

1. 打开“套餐管理 → 基础套餐”。先在“套餐分组”页签添加至少一个分组。
2. 回到“基础套餐”页签点“添加套餐”，按区块填写：基础归属（名称、分组、线路组、备用分组）、资源限制（月流量、带宽、连接数、域名数等，以及 WAF、CC、HTTP3 等开关）、定价（月付、季度付、年付，单位元）、CNAME 设置、购买限制。
3. 保存后回到列表核对名称、状态和资源限制；需要用户自助购买时确认分组“在售可见”。
4. 给已有用户开通或调整套餐，到“套餐管理 → 已售套餐”处理；升级包、流量包分别在“升级包”“流量包”里配置。

修改套餐的 CNAME 域名、主机名或模式并保存后，该套餐所有在用订阅会同步新配置，套餐下的网站自动重新生成 CNAME，页面显示同步进度；单独在“已售套餐”里改过 CNAME 的订阅和存在未来生效版本的订阅会被跳过并列出原因。

用户看不到套餐时，先确认套餐所在分组在售可见、用户已开通，以及当前操作的是正确的主控。余额和手工调账在“财务管理”里办理，不要用改套餐代替资金调整。

## 开通代理商 {#resellers}

代理商是平台开给它一部分线路组、让它用这些线路组建自己的套餐、再卖给自己客户的用户。本版只支持一级代理：平台 → 代理商 → 代理商的客户。

开通代理商（平台管理员操作）：

1. 在“系统管理 → 用户列表”打开用户的“编辑”，切到“代理商”页签。
2. 打开“开通为代理商”，填写“批发价表”（默认 standard）、“预付余额提醒线”（元，0 表示不提醒）和“客户上限”（留空表示不限），点“开通代理商”。
3. 回到用户列表，“类型”列显示“代理商”。

把线路组授权给代理商：

1. 打开“节点管理 → 线路分组”，在下方“线路组等级与授权”给线路组标等级（普通、高防、无限防）。
2. 在要授权的线路组行点“授权给代理商”，搜索并选择代理商，点“授权”。

计费方式：代理商先给平台预付，客户在代理商处下单时按批发价从代理商预付余额扣给平台，售价由代理商自己定，不能低于批发价。代理商的客户只能购买所属代理商的套餐；加购包、流量包仍买平台的。

把已有用户转给代理商：在该用户“代理商”页签的“所属代理商”里选择代理商并保存；原有订阅保留到到期。选“平台直客”可转回平台。

停用与撤销：

- 代理商“停用”后不能新建套餐、新开客户和新下单；已售订阅照常用到到期，客户不能再续费该代理商的套餐。
- 撤销线路组授权时，代理商引用这条线路组的在售套餐自动下架，套餐里用它做 B/C 升级的设置被清掉；已售订阅用到到期为止。

> 本版平台侧的批发价目前没有单独的维护页面，代理商一侧建套餐、查看收支的完整界面也还在补充中。需要设置批发价或由代理商自助建套餐时，请先联系平台确认当前办理方式。

## 充值、调账与订单 {#finance}

- “财务管理 → 用户充值”为用户充值；“人工余额调整”用于有审批的手工调账，并会留下记录。
- “所有订单”“充值订单”“充值统计”用于对账。订单状态不明时先查订单，不要重复充值。
- 用户自助充值的收款渠道在“收款通道”页面配置，在“使用场景”里勾选“本站充值”。只开通“本站充值”不等于开通了节点市场收款，节点市场见[节点供货商](/docs/market-supplier#payments)。
- “收款通道”目前不在侧栏里，地址是主控地址后加 /dashboard/finance/payment-channels，例如 https://console.cdnca.com/dashboard/finance/payment-channels。需要“管理收款通道”权限。

涉及余额、充值和手工调账的操作按组织的审批流程处理。
body.en:
For control-plane administrators: adding users, configuring plans, enabling resellers, and handling top-ups and orders.

## Add or change users {#users}

1. Open "System → User list", click "Add user", fill in the username, e-mail and other details and save. Find existing users by username, display name, e-mail or phone.
2. Open the user's "Edit" and check the "Basic", "Identity" and "Sign-in security" tabs, the user group and what happens at expiry.
3. Grant only the permissions the user needs; do not give regular users admin rights.
4. Ask the user to sign in again and confirm they see only their own resources.

To troubleshoot as the user, click "Switch" in the user list to enter their user console; click "Exit impersonation" when done. Users manage their own members and sub-accounts under "Account → Members & sub-accounts".

## Plans {#packages}

A plan sets how many resources a user gets, which features, which line and the site CNAME.

1. Open "Plans → Base plans". Add at least one group on the "Plan groups" tab first.
2. On the "Base plans" tab click "Add plan" and fill in each section: ownership (name, groups, line group, standby group), resource limits (monthly traffic, bandwidth, connections, domains and switches such as WAF, CC, HTTP3), pricing (monthly, quarterly, yearly in yuan), CNAME settings and purchase limits.
3. Save and check name, status and limits in the list; for self-service purchase make sure the group is visible for sale.
4. Give or change plans for existing users under "Plans → Sold plans"; add-ons and traffic packs are under "Upgrade packs" and "Traffic packs".

When you change a plan's CNAME domain, host name or mode, every active subscription of that plan picks up the new settings and the plan's sites regenerate their CNAMEs; the page shows progress. Subscriptions whose CNAME was changed individually under "Sold plans", or that have a future version, are skipped and listed with the reason.

If a user cannot see a plan, check that its group is visible, the user has it, and you are on the right control plane. Balances and manual adjustments belong under "Finance"; do not use plan edits to adjust money.

## Resellers {#resellers}

A reseller is a user the platform grants some line groups to, who builds its own plans from them and sells them to its own customers. This release supports one level only: platform → reseller → reseller's customers.

Enable a reseller (platform administrator):

1. In "System → User list", open the user's "Edit" and go to the "Reseller" tab.
2. Turn on "Enable as reseller", set the wholesale price list (default standard), the low-balance reminder (yuan, 0 means none) and the customer limit (empty means unlimited), and click "Enable reseller".
3. The user list's "Type" column now shows "Reseller".

Grant line groups to a reseller:

1. Open "Nodes → Line groups" and, in "Line group tiers and grants" below, set each group's tier (normal, high defence, unlimited defence).
2. On the group's row click "Grant to reseller", choose the reseller and click "Grant".

Billing: the reseller prepays the platform. When a customer orders from the reseller, the wholesale price is taken from the reseller's prepaid balance; the reseller sets its own retail price, which cannot be below wholesale. A reseller's customers can only buy that reseller's plans; add-ons and traffic packs are still bought from the platform.

Move an existing user to a reseller: on the user's "Reseller" tab choose the reseller under "Parent reseller" and save; existing subscriptions stay until they expire. Choose "Platform customer" to move them back.

Suspend and revoke:

- A suspended reseller cannot create plans, add customers or place orders; sold subscriptions run until they expire and customers cannot renew that reseller's plans.
- Revoking a line-group grant delists the reseller's on-sale plans that use it and clears its B/C escalation settings; sold subscriptions run until they expire.

> In this release there is no separate page for the platform's wholesale prices, and the reseller's own screens for building plans and viewing income are still being completed. Ask the platform how to set wholesale prices or have a reseller build plans before relying on it.

## Top-ups, adjustments and orders {#finance}

- "Finance → User top-up" tops up a user; "Manual balance adjustment" is for approved adjustments and leaves a record.
- "All orders", "Top-up orders" and "Top-up statistics" are for reconciliation. If an order's state is unclear, check it before topping up again.
- Self-service top-ups are paid through a channel set on the "Payment channels" page with "Site top-up" ticked under its uses. "Site top-up" alone does not enable node-market payments; see [node supplier](/docs/market-supplier#payments).
- "Payment channels" is not in the sidebar yet. Open /dashboard/finance/payment-channels on your control plane, for example https://console.cdnca.com/dashboard/finance/payment-channels. It needs the "manage payment channels" permission.

Follow your organisation's approval process for balances, top-ups and manual adjustments.

description.zh: 主控系统配置、日志与后台任务、网关管理、通过直达地址打开的页面，以及维护升级与备份入口。
description.en: Control-plane settings, logs and background tasks, gateways, pages opened by direct address, and maintenance, upgrades and backups.

body.zh:
本篇面向客户主控管理员：系统设置、日志与任务、公告与工单、网关，以及插件、主题和第三方服务商这些通过直达地址打开的页面。

## 系统配置 {#settings}

打开“系统管理 → 系统配置”，按页签修改：系统配置、数据清理、账号与安全、认证与支付、发信配置、通知设置、其它配置、WAF 自适应。

- 修改前先读页面上的范围说明。系统配置会影响所有用户，先与其他管理员确认维护时间和恢复办法。
- 保存后刷新页面确认新值；页面提示结果待确认时，按提示用原请求重试或刷新核对。
- 右上角账号菜单的“设置”也能进入这里。

## 日志、任务与消息 {#logs}

| 想看什么 | 去哪里 |
| --- | --- |
| 网站、证书、节点等操作是否完成 | 系统管理 → 后台任务 |
| 管理员操作记录 | 系统管理 → 系统日志、日志中心 |
| 网站访问、拦截、WAF 记录 | 统计分析 → 访问日志、拉黑日志、WAF日志、拦截事件明细 |
| 节点、攻击、对账等系统提醒 | 顶栏铃铛 → 站内消息 |
| 给用户发公告 | 系统管理 → 公告管理 |
| 用户工单 | 系统管理 → 工单（认领、回复、内部备注、改状态和优先级） |

后台任务显示完成、且业务页面的网站、节点或证书状态与任务结果一致，才算真正完成。

## 网关管理 {#gateways}

节点通过网关连接主控。默认网关随主控一起安装。需要独立网关时，在“系统管理 → 网关管理”点“添加网关”，到网关机上以 root 执行页面给出的安装命令；令牌只显示一次，过期或丢失点“重发令牌”。

## 通过直达地址打开的页面 {#direct-pages}

下面这些页面目前不在左侧菜单里，从相关页面的按钮进入，或在主控地址后直接加路径打开（例如 https://console.cdnca.com/dashboard/sys/plugin-store）：

| 页面 | 路径 | 用途 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 插件商店 | /dashboard/sys/plugin-store | 购买、下载、启用插件，见[插件安装与使用](/docs/plugins) |
| 主题 | /dashboard/sys/themes | 启用和自定义主题（系统配置页有入口） |
| 第三方服务商插件 | /dashboard/sys/plugin-providers | DNS、短信、备案查询、支付、邮件插件的契约测试与启用 |
| 节点市场 | /dashboard/sys/node-market | 节点供货与订阅，见[节点供货商](/docs/market-supplier)、[节点订阅方](/docs/market-subscriber) |
| 收款通道 | /dashboard/finance/payment-channels | 本站充值与节点市场直结收款 |
| CNAME 分配权威 | /dashboard/node/cname-allocations | 查看 CNAME 分配和站点诊断 |
| 站内消息 | /dashboard/sys/inbox | 系统提醒，顶栏铃铛也能进入 |

打开后显示无权限时，请有权限的管理员核对账号角色；显示功能未开通时，确认授权是否包含对应模块。

## 维护升级与备份 {#maintenance}

“系统管理 → 维护升级”有两个页签：

- “系统升级”：查看主控当前版本和可用升级，升级主控；在“节点升级”里查看节点版本并升级节点。升级只在这里办理，不要手工替换主控或节点的程序文件。
- “维护操作”：主控备份与迁移（立即备份、定时备份、异地存储、导出恢复密钥、迁移主控）。

详见[重启、升级、卸载与迁移](/docs/operations)。
body.en:
For control-plane administrators: system settings, logs and tasks, announcements and tickets, gateways, and the pages for plugins, themes and third-party providers that open by direct address.

## System settings {#settings}

Open "System → System settings" and use the tabs: system, data cleanup, account and security, identity and payments, mail, notifications, other, adaptive WAF.

- Read the scope note on the page first. System settings affect every user; agree a maintenance window and a way back with other admins.
- Refresh after saving to confirm the new value; if the page says the result is pending, retry with the original request or refresh to check.
- "Settings" in the account menu (top right) opens the same page.

## Logs, tasks and messages {#logs}

| What you want | Where |
| --- | --- |
| Whether site, certificate or node operations finished | System → Background tasks |
| Admin activity | System → System log, Log centre |
| Site access, blocks and WAF events | Analytics → Access log, Block log, WAF log, Block events |
| System reminders for nodes, attacks, reconciliation | Bell icon in the header → Messages |
| Announcements to users | System → Announcements |
| User tickets | System → Tickets (claim, reply, internal notes, status and priority) |

A change is done only when the background task has finished and the site, node or certificate page shows the same state.

## Gateways {#gateways}

Nodes connect to the control plane through a gateway. The default gateway is installed with the control plane. For a separate gateway, click "Add gateway" under "System → Gateways" and run the install command shown on the gateway host as root; the token is shown once, use "New token" if it expired or was lost.

## Pages opened by direct address {#direct-pages}

These pages are not in the sidebar yet. Open them from buttons on related pages, or add the path to your control-plane address (for example https://console.cdnca.com/dashboard/sys/plugin-store):

| Page | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Plugin store | /dashboard/sys/plugin-store | Buy, download and enable plugins; see [plugins](/docs/plugins) |
| Themes | /dashboard/sys/themes | Enable and customise themes (linked from system settings) |
| Third-party provider plugins | /dashboard/sys/plugin-providers | Contract tests and enabling for DNS, SMS, ICP lookup, payment and mail plugins |
| Node market | /dashboard/sys/node-market | Supplying and subscribing to nodes; see [node supplier](/docs/market-supplier) and [node subscriber](/docs/market-subscriber) |
| Payment channels | /dashboard/finance/payment-channels | Site top-ups and node-market direct payments |
| CNAME allocation authority | /dashboard/node/cname-allocations | CNAME allocations and site diagnosis |
| Messages | /dashboard/sys/inbox | System reminders; also from the bell icon |

If a page says you have no permission, ask an administrator to check your role; if it says the feature is not enabled, check that your licence includes the module.

## Maintenance, upgrades and backups {#maintenance}

"System → Maintenance & upgrade" has two tabs:

- "System upgrade": the control plane's current version and available upgrades; upgrade the control plane, and under "Node upgrade" check node versions and upgrade nodes. Upgrade only here; never replace control-plane or node binaries by hand.
- "Maintenance actions": control-plane backup and migration (back up now, scheduled backups, off-site storage, export the recovery key, migrate).

See [restart, upgrade, uninstall and migrate](/docs/operations).

description.zh: cdnca 主控与节点的重启、查看日志、升级、备份、节点卸载与主控迁移。
description.en: Restart, logs, upgrades, backups, node uninstall and control-plane migration for cdnca.

body.zh:
主控与节点的重启、查看日志、升级、备份、卸载和迁移。命令都在对应服务器上以 root 执行。

## 重启 {#restart}

主控：

```
systemctl restart cdnca-control-api cdnca-agent-gateway cdnca-control-nats cdnca-control-web
```

节点：

```
systemctl restart cdnca-edge-agent
```

> 节点没有单独的 OpenResty 服务，OpenResty 由 cdnca-edge-agent 拉起并管理。重启 cdnca-edge-agent 不会重启 OpenResty，也不会中断正在转发的连接；OpenResty 未在运行时，Agent 启动后会自动把它拉起。

## 查看日志 {#logs}

```
journalctl -u cdnca-control-api -n 200 --no-pager
```

节点上把 cdnca-control-api 换成 cdnca-edge-agent。安装过程的完整输出在 /var/log/cdnca-install-control-*.log 和 /var/log/cdnca-install-node-*.log。

## 升级 {#upgrade}

只在主控后台“系统管理 → 维护升级 → 系统升级”里升级（可以指定版本）。节点在同一页的“节点升级”里由主控统一推送，可以按节点查看日志。不要手工替换二进制文件。

升级中显示“升级失败，已回滚”时，系统已回到原版本；点“查看日志”记录失败原因后联系技术支持，不要反复重试。

## 备份 {#backup}

在“系统管理 → 维护升级 → 维护操作”的“主控备份与迁移”里：

1. 点“立即备份”。备份时会停止 control-api、Gateway 与升级程序，管理后台暂时不可用（通常几分钟），完成后自动恢复；节点继续服务。
2. 在“定时备份”里选择星期和时间、本机保留份数、异地保留份数，点“保存设置”。
3. 在“异地存储”添加 S3/RustFS 或 SFTP，填写后点“测试连接”，显示“连接正常”再保存。测试连接用的是当前填写的内容，不必先保存。
4. 点“导出恢复密钥”，设置至少 12 个字符的恢复口令。原主控整机丢失时，要凭恢复密钥文件与口令才能解开异地备份；口令不会保存，请与文件分开保管。

在“备份列表”和“运行记录”里核对每次备份的时间、大小和签名是否“有效”。备份签名指纹请另外记录，恢复时用于确认备份来自本主控。

## 卸载节点 {#uninstall-node}

```
/usr/libexec/cdnca-edge-agent/uninstall.sh
```

加 --purge 会同时删除节点身份与本地状态（会要求确认）：

```
/usr/libexec/cdnca-edge-agent/uninstall.sh --purge
```

卸载前先在主控停用或删除这台节点，并确认它不再承担网站流量。

## 卸载主控 {#uninstall-control}

主控没有卸载脚本。需要彻底移除时请重装系统。

## 迁移主控到新服务器 {#migrate}

迁移会把本主控整体搬到一台全新服务器：新服务器安装同版本依赖 → 旧主控冻结并加密备份 → 传输 → 新服务器恢复并校验。

准备：

1. 一台全新系统的新服务器。
2. 在授权中心打开授权详情，在“迁移下载 IP”里填写新服务器的公网 IP，让新服务器在有效期内能下载安装包。迁移沿用原安装，不需要新的安装命令；迁移完成后再点“修改主控 IP”改成新服务器。

方式一，在旧主控后台操作：在“维护操作 → 迁移主控”填写新主控 IP 或域名、SSH 端口、用户和登录方式，点“获取指纹”并核对主机指纹，输入新主控地址确认后点“开始迁移”。开始后旧主控管理后台立即停止，结果在新主控查看。

方式二，在新服务器上执行，安装器会经 SSH 从旧主控取加密备份并恢复，等待节点重连：

```
bash install-control.sh migrate-from root@旧主控IP --ssh-port 22 --wait-nodes 10m
```

完成后：

- 把管理端域名与网关域名的 DNS 改到新服务器，节点会自动重连。
- 在新主控确认登录、节点在线、网站访问正常后，再关闭旧主控。旧主控迁移后保持冻结，避免两套主控同时写入。
- 需要回切时，把 DNS 改回旧主控，并在旧主控的维护操作页解除冻结。
body.en:
Restart, logs, upgrades, backups, uninstall and migration for the control plane and nodes. Run the commands as root on the relevant server.

## Restart {#restart}

Control plane:

```
systemctl restart cdnca-control-api cdnca-agent-gateway cdnca-control-nats cdnca-control-web
```

Node:

```
systemctl restart cdnca-edge-agent
```

> There is no separate OpenResty service on the node: cdnca-edge-agent starts and manages OpenResty. Restarting cdnca-edge-agent does not restart OpenResty and keeps active connections; if OpenResty is not running, the Agent starts it when it comes up.

## Logs {#logs}

```
journalctl -u cdnca-control-api -n 200 --no-pager
```

On a node use cdnca-edge-agent instead. The full install output is in /var/log/cdnca-install-control-*.log and /var/log/cdnca-install-node-*.log.

## Upgrade {#upgrade}

Upgrade only from "System → Maintenance & upgrade → System upgrade" in the console (a version can be pinned). Nodes are upgraded from "Node upgrade" on the same page, with a log per node. Never replace binaries by hand.

If an upgrade shows "upgrade failed, rolled back", the system is back on the previous version. Use "View logs" to note the reason and contact support rather than retrying again and again.

## Backup {#backup}

Under "System → Maintenance & upgrade → Maintenance actions", in "Control backup and migration":

1. Click "Back up now". The backup stops control-api, the gateway and the upgrader, so the console is unavailable for a few minutes and then comes back; nodes keep serving.
2. Under "Scheduled backups" choose days and time and how many copies to keep locally and off-site, then "Save settings".
3. Under "Off-site storage" add S3/RustFS or SFTP, click "Test" and save once it reports the connection is OK. The test uses what you have typed; you do not need to save first.
4. Click "Export recovery key" and set a recovery passphrase of at least 12 characters. If the control plane is lost entirely, you need the key file and the passphrase to open off-site backups. The passphrase is not stored; keep it apart from the file.

Check each backup's time, size and signature status in the backup list and run history. Record the backup signing fingerprint separately; it confirms on restore that a backup came from this control plane.

## Uninstall a node {#uninstall-node}

```
/usr/libexec/cdnca-edge-agent/uninstall.sh
```

Add --purge to also delete the node identity and local state (asks for confirmation):

```
/usr/libexec/cdnca-edge-agent/uninstall.sh --purge
```

Disable or delete the node in the console first and make sure it no longer carries site traffic.

## Uninstall the control plane {#uninstall-control}

There is no uninstall script for the control plane. Reinstall the OS to remove it completely.

## Move the control plane to a new server {#migrate}

Migration moves the whole control plane to a fresh server: install matching dependencies there → freeze and encrypt a backup on the old one → transfer → restore and verify on the new one.

Prepare:

1. A freshly installed new server.
2. In the licence centre open the licence details and set the new server's public IP under "Migration download IP", so the new server can download the packages within the validity period. The migration keeps the existing installation and needs no new install command; once it is done, use "Change master IP" to switch to the new server.

Option 1, from the old console: in "Maintenance actions → Migrate control plane" enter the new server's IP or domain, SSH port, user and sign-in method, click "Fetch fingerprint" and check the host key, type the new address to confirm and click "Start migration". The old console stops immediately; check the result on the new one.

Option 2, on the new server; the installer fetches an encrypted backup from the old server over SSH, restores it and waits for nodes to reconnect:

```
bash install-control.sh migrate-from root@旧主控IP --ssh-port 22 --wait-nodes 10m
```

Afterwards:

- Point the console and gateway domains at the new server; nodes reconnect by themselves.
- Shut down the old server only after you can sign in, nodes are online and sites work on the new one. The old server stays frozen after migration so the two never write at the same time.
- To roll back, point DNS back to the old server and unfreeze it on its maintenance page.

description.zh: 主控普通用户管理自己的网站、域名解析、刷新预热、源站、HTTPS、误拦截、套餐账单和账户安全。
description.en: For regular users: your sites, DNS, purge and prewarm, origins, HTTPS, false positives, plans and bills, and account security.

body.zh:
本篇面向主控下的普通用户（站长）：在用户端管理自己的网站、源站、HTTPS、缓存、防护、套餐和账户。

能否新建网站、查看套餐和账单、创建 API 密钥，取决于当前账号的权限。页面上没有相应的按钮时，请联系本主控管理员确认，不要借用管理员账号。

## 添加或管理自己的网站 {#site}

1. 登录用户端，打开“网站管理 → 网站列表”。
2. 当前账号有网站管理权限、且页面显示“添加网站”时，可以在这里创建网站：选择套餐，填写网站域名和源站地址后提交（字段说明见[添加网站](/docs/admin-sites#add-site)）。没有这个按钮时，搜索自己已有或管理员分配的域名。
3. 进入网站详情，按需查看“基本配置”“回源设置”“HTTPS设置”“缓存设置”和防护相关页签。
4. 修改后点页面顶部的“保存更改”。页面提示有未保存的修改时，先保存或放弃，再离开。
5. 回到列表或刷新详情，确认修改后的值仍在。

打不开某个网站时，先确认它属于当前账号或已分配给你。保存提示冲突时，重新加载最新配置，确认没有覆盖别人的修改再改。

## 给网站域名添加解析 {#domain}

1. 在“网站列表”找到网站，复制“CNAME”列的值。
2. 登录管理该域名的 DNS 服务商，选择自己的域名，添加一条 CNAME 记录。例如网站是 www.cdnca.com，主机记录填 www，记录值填刚复制的完整 CNAME。
3. 保存后等待 DNS 更新，再访问网站。需要 HTTPS 时继续看[启用 HTTPS](#https)。

CNAME 列显示“生成中”时稍等，页面会自动刷新；显示“生成失败”或一直没有值时，把域名和页面提示交给本主控管理员。不要把源站 IP 当作 CNAME 记录值。

## 刷新与预热 {#cache}

网站更新后访客仍看到旧内容时，刷新缓存。

1. 打开“网站管理 → 刷新预热”，选择“刷新 URL”“刷新目录”或“预热”。
2. 在“URL 列表”里每行填一个完整地址：
   - 刷新 URL、预热：例如 https://www.cdnca.com/assets/logo.png。
   - 刷新目录：以 / 结尾，例如 https://www.cdnca.com/assets/。
3. 点“提交任务”，在弹出的“创建刷新预热任务”里填写本网站的“站点 ID”，核对任务类型和目标地址。节点一栏留空表示发往承载该网站的全部节点。
4. 在弹窗里点“提交任务”，看到结果后关闭。
5. 切到“操作记录”，按站点和状态找到任务，点“查看详情”查看每个节点的结果。

“站点 ID”是网站的完整编号，不是域名，也不是列表里显示的短编号。不确定时请本主控管理员提供，不要把域名填进去。一次最多 500 个地址；页面会显示今日额度。

部分失败时先在详情里看失败原因，再点“重试失败项”。提交后连接中断时，先看操作记录里有没有这条任务，不要另建一条相同的任务。

## 修改源站 {#origin}

1. 打开“网站管理 → 网站列表”，进入网站详情的“回源设置”。
2. 在源站列表点编辑或新增，填写源站地址、端口等必填项。只填写自己有权管理、且节点能访问到的源站。
3. 在源站弹窗点“确认”。这一步只更新页面上的草稿，回到网站编辑页核对源站列表已显示本次修改。
4. 点页面顶部的“保存更改”，等待保存结果；重新打开网站，确认地址和发布结果。

校验失败时按字段提示核对；提示结果待确认时，点“加载最新配置”核对后再改。切换后访问异常，先改回原源站并联系管理员查看访问日志，不要提交没验证过的备用地址。

## 启用 HTTPS 或处理证书到期 {#https}

1. 打开“网站管理 → 证书管理”，确认有覆盖网站域名、未过期的证书。没有时在“自动申请”里点“申请证书”，或在“证书资产”里上传并激活证书。
2. 打开网站详情的“HTTPS设置”，打开“HTTPS访问”，按实际入口填写“HTTPS监听端口”。需要 HTTP 自动跳转时再打开“强制HTTPS”。
3. 在“证书”里选择覆盖当前网站域名的有效证书，点“应用证书”，页面提示证书已绑定、发布任务已进入队列。
4. 回到证书管理和网站详情检查证书、到期时间和发布结果，再用浏览器访问 https://www.cdnca.com 确认。

证书申请失败时核对 DNS 和验证方式；已绑定但访问异常时核对证书覆盖的域名和发布状态。快到期时先确认自动续期，旧证书仍有效时不要先解绑。自动申请和续期进度可以在“证书订单与续期状态”页查看，它目前不在侧栏里，地址是主控地址后加 /dashboard/site/cert/orders。

## 处理误拦截 {#security}

1. 记录受影响的时间、域名、请求地址（去掉带敏感信息的参数）和页面显示的请求编号。
2. 打开“统计分析 → 网站拉黑日志”“WAF日志”或“拦截事件明细”，按域名和时间找到记录，看命中的规则和处理结果。
3. 把命中的规则、时间、脱敏后的地址和请求编号交给本主控管理员。当前账号能管理这条规则、且确认了影响范围时，也可以只调整命中的那条规则或加一条精确例外。不要关闭整站防护，也不要放行宽泛网段。
4. 调整后重新测试受影响的请求和正常请求，再查日志确认结果。

找不到记录时扩大时间范围，并核对日志类型。不要提交带密码或令牌的请求内容。

## 套餐、用量与账单 {#billing}

1. “套餐管理 → 我的套餐”：查看套餐名称、状态和到期时间。
2. “套餐管理 → 套餐购买”：购买或续订时核对商品、价格、资源限制、有效期和应付金额。
3. “套餐管理 → 流量包”与“用量查询”：查看流量包余额和消耗流水，或按套餐和日期查看用量；单次查询不超过 167 天。
4. “套餐管理 → 监控告警”：查看套餐告警和周期状态。
5. “账户中心 → 消费记录”查看订单；“账户余额”“余额流水”核对充值和扣款。

订单已生成但套餐没出现时，先核对订单；付款结果不确定时不要重复付款。套餐到期或告警异常时，记录套餐名称、时间和请求编号，联系本主控管理员。

## 账户与安全 {#account}

- “账户中心 → 个人资料”：资料、密码与登录安全。
- “API密钥”：创建密钥时只给需要的权限；密钥只显示一次，请妥善保存。泄露时立即“撤销”并重新创建。
- “成员与子账号”“自定义角色”：给同一账户下的其他人开账号和分配权限（需要相应权限）。
- “消息订阅”“消息查询”与顶栏铃铛的“站内消息”：系统提醒，例如网站遭受大流量攻击、需要更换 CNAME 等。
- “工单”：遇到问题提交工单，客服回复后按消息订阅通知你。

不要通过截图或聊天发送完整的 API 密钥。

## 插件 {#plugins}

管理员提供给本账号的插件在“插件市场”里确认安装、升级和停用，见[插件安装与使用](/docs/plugins#tenant)。“插件市场”目前不在侧栏里，地址是主控地址后加 /dashboard/sys/plugin-market，例如 https://console.cdnca.com/dashboard/sys/plugin-market。
body.en:
For regular users (site owners) on a control plane: managing your own sites, origins, HTTPS, cache, protection, plans and account in the user console.

Whether you can create sites, see plans and bills or create API keys depends on your account's permissions. If a button is missing, ask your control-plane administrator; do not borrow an admin account.

## Add or manage your sites {#site}

1. Sign in to the user console and open "Sites → Site list".
2. If your account can manage sites and the page shows "Add site", create one here: choose a plan, enter the domains and origin and submit (fields are explained in [add a site](/docs/admin-sites#add-site)). Otherwise search for your own or assigned domains.
3. Open the site and use the "Basic", "Origin", "HTTPS settings", "Cache" and protection tabs as needed.
4. Click "Save changes" at the top after editing. If the page warns about unsaved changes, save or discard them before leaving.
5. Go back to the list or refresh to confirm the change stuck.

If a site will not open, check that it belongs to or is assigned to your account. On a save conflict, load the latest configuration, make sure you are not overwriting someone else's change, then edit again.

## Point your domain {#domain}

1. Find the site in "Site list" and copy the value in the "CNAME" column.
2. Sign in to the DNS provider for the domain and add a CNAME record. For www.cdnca.com the host is www and the value is the full CNAME you copied.
3. Save, wait for DNS to update and open the site. For HTTPS continue with [enable HTTPS](#https).

If the CNAME column shows "Generating", wait; the page refreshes by itself. If it shows "Generation failed" or stays empty, send the domain and the message to your administrator. Never use the origin IP as the CNAME value.

## Purge and prewarm {#cache}

When visitors still see old content after an update, purge the cache.

1. Open "Sites → Purge and prewarm" and choose "Purge URL", "Purge directory" or "Prewarm".
2. Enter one full address per line in the URL list:
   - Purge URL and prewarm: for example https://www.cdnca.com/assets/logo.png.
   - Purge directory: ending in /, for example https://www.cdnca.com/assets/.
3. Click "Submit task". In "Create purge/prewarm task" enter this site's "Site ID" and check the task type and targets. Leave the node field empty to send it to every node serving the site.
4. Click "Submit task" in the dialog and close it once you see the result.
5. Open "Operation history", find the task by site and state and click "View details" for each node's result.

"Site ID" is the site's full identifier, not the domain and not the short number shown in the list. If unsure, ask your administrator for it; do not type the domain there. Up to 500 addresses per task; the page shows today's quota.

If some items fail, read the reason in the details and click "Retry failed items". If the connection drops after submitting, check the history before creating the same task again.

## Change the origin {#origin}

1. Open "Sites → Site list" and go to the site's "Origin" tab.
2. Edit or add an origin and fill in the address, port and other required fields. Use only origins you manage and the nodes can reach.
3. Click "Confirm" in the origin dialog. This only updates the draft; check the origin list on the site page.
4. Click "Save changes" at the top and wait for the result; reopen the site to check the address and publish result.

Fix validation errors as the fields say; if the result is pending, click "Load latest configuration" before editing again. If the site breaks after switching, switch back and ask your administrator to check the access logs; do not submit untested fallback addresses.

## Enable HTTPS or handle expiry {#https}

1. Open "Sites → Certificates" and make sure a valid certificate covers the site's domains. If not, click "Request certificate" on the "Automatic" tab, or upload and activate one on the "Certificate assets" tab.
2. Open the site's "HTTPS settings", turn on "HTTPS access" and set the HTTPS ports. Turn on "Force HTTPS" if HTTP should redirect.
3. Under "Certificate" choose a valid certificate for the site's domains and click "Apply certificate"; the page confirms it is bound and the publish task is queued.
4. Check the certificate, expiry and publish result, then open https://www.cdnca.com in a browser.

If a request fails, check DNS and the validation method; if it is bound but HTTPS fails, check the domains it covers and the publish state. Near expiry, confirm auto-renewal first and do not unbind a still-valid certificate. Request and renewal progress is on the "Certificate orders and renewal status" page, which is not in the sidebar yet: add /dashboard/site/cert/orders to your control-plane address.

## False positives {#security}

1. Note the time, domain, request address (without sensitive parameters) and the request ID shown on the page.
2. Open "Analytics → Site block log", "WAF log" or "Block events", find the record by domain and time, and see which rule matched and what happened.
3. Send the rule, time, cleaned address and request ID to your administrator. If your account manages that rule and you understand the impact, you may change only that rule or add a narrow exception. Do not turn off protection for the whole site or allow broad networks.
4. Test the affected request and normal requests again, then check the logs.

If you find nothing, widen the time range and check the log type. Never submit request content with passwords or tokens.

## Plans, usage and bills {#billing}

1. "Plans → My plans": name, status and expiry.
2. "Plans → Buy plans": check product, price, limits, term and amount before buying or renewing.
3. "Plans → Traffic packs" and "Usage": traffic balance and usage history, or usage per plan and date; one query covers at most 167 days.
4. "Plans → Monitoring alerts": plan alerts and period status.
5. "Account → Consumption records" for orders; "Account balance" and "Balance ledger" for top-ups and charges.

If an order exists but the plan does not show, check the order; if a payment is unclear, do not pay again. For expiry or alert problems, note the plan, time and request ID and contact your administrator.

## Account and security {#account}

- "Account → Profile": details, password and sign-in security.
- "API keys": give a key only the permissions it needs; it is shown once, so store it safely. If it leaks, "Revoke" it at once and create a new one.
- "Members & sub-accounts" and "Custom roles": accounts and permissions for others under your account (needs the right permission).
- "Message subscription", "Messages" and the bell icon: reminders such as a site under heavy attack or a CNAME that must change.
- "Tickets": submit a ticket; you are notified according to your message subscription when support replies.

Never send a full API key in screenshots or chats.

## Plugins {#plugins}

Plugins your administrator provides are confirmed, upgraded and disabled in "Plugin market"; see [plugins](/docs/plugins#tenant). "Plugin market" is not in the sidebar yet: add /dashboard/sys/plugin-market to your control-plane address, for example https://console.cdnca.com/dashboard/sys/plugin-market.

description.zh: 在授权中心查看与筛选授权、购买或领取免费授权、续费、修改主控 IP、生成安装命令、充值与资料。
description.en: In the licence centre: view and filter licences, buy or claim free licences, renew, change the control-plane IP, generate install commands, top up and profile.

body.zh:
授权中心（授权门户）用于办理与主控授权有关的事：查看和续费授权、生成主控安装命令、充值、查看订单和资料。添加节点、配置网站、管理用户请回到自己的主控管理端。

## 查看自己的授权 {#licenses}

1. 登录授权中心，打开左侧“我的授权”。
2. 用上方的状态页签切换“使用中”“即将到期”“已逾期”“已删除”“全部”。试用剩余 3 天内、其他授权剩余 30 天内才算“即将到期”；新开通的试用显示“正常”和剩余天数。不确定在哪个状态时选“全部”。
3. 需要找某一份授权时，在搜索框输入授权 ID、商品、IP、域名或备注；也可以用“全部商品”和“到期时间”（7、30、90 天内到期）筛选。
4. 列表里核对商品名称、“授权 IP”“授权域名”、节点数量、授权到期时间、服务到期时间、状态和备注。“授权 IP”“授权域名”可以直接复制；有多个域名时显示“+N”，鼠标悬停可看全部。
5. 点授权进入详情，查看购买信息、授权详情（授权 IP、授权域名、授权码、剩余重置次数）和右侧的安装说明。

列表为空不代表授权被删除，先清除搜索和筛选，再切到“全部”。仍找不到时，确认当前登录的是购买或领取这份授权的账号，联系平台时提供订单时间或订单号，不要公开完整激活凭据。

“授权域名”显示的是主控上报的访问域名，主控还没上报时显示“主控未上报”。

## 购买、领取免费授权或续费 {#purchase}

1. 在“我的授权”页面上方的授权套餐卡片里，查看节点数、价格、有效期和每个账号可领取的份数。
2. 点“立即购买”，选择“套餐选择”“购买时长”，填写“主控IP”（主控服务器的公网 IP，只允许这个 IP 激活和下载管理端）。
3. 核对“应付金额”。免费授权显示“免费，无需支付”，点“确定”即可；收费授权从余额扣款，余额不足时先充值。
4. 回到“我的授权”和“我的订单”，确认新授权和订单记录。

续费：在列表勾选一份授权点“批量续费”，或在授权行点“续费”，核对套餐和时长后确定。免费授权可在详情点“升级授权”就地升级为付费套餐，已安装的管理端和主控 IP 保持不变。

购买前页面要求实名时，按提示点“去实名认证”。已领取过免费授权时，先在“使用中”和“全部”里找。订单或付款结果不清楚时先查“我的订单”，不要重复提交。

## 修改主控 IP {#master-ip}

授权只允许登记的主控 IP 激活和下载管理端。服务器换了公网 IP、还没安装时：

1. 打开授权详情，在“授权详情”里点“修改主控 IP”。
2. 在“修改主控IP”弹窗填写新的公网 IP，确认新旧 IP 后点“确认修改”。修改后旧 IP 不能再激活或下载管理端。24 小时内最多修改 10 次，详情里的“剩余重置次数”显示还能改几次。
3. 在弹窗的“变更记录”里核对修改。

## 生成主控安装命令 {#install}

在授权详情右侧“安装说明”点“一键安装脚本”→“生成安装命令”→“复制”。完整步骤见[主控安装](/docs/install-control)。

授权已经装过主控时，详情页不再生成首装命令，改为显示“换服务器”。修改主控 IP 或迁移下载 IP 不会解除旧主控的绑定。整机迁移用旧主控的“迁移主控”，沿用原安装，见[迁移到新服务器](/docs/operations#migrate)；全新重装或旧主控已无法使用时，复制“换服务器”里的授权编号和主控编号，联系授权运营办理。授权详情里的限制说明以服务端为准：服务账户被暂停时，授权本身状态不变，但不能生成安装命令、续费或修改授权，资料和订单照常可看，请联系服务方恢复账户；授权暂停时联系服务方恢复授权；到期时先续费；未生效时等生效时间。

## 余额与订单 {#balance}

1. 打开“余额充值”查看账户余额和充值方式。
2. 目前充值采用对公账户人工充值：用已认证企业的银行账户转账到页面公布的账户，并联系客服提供用户名与转账凭证，到账后由运营人员入账。页面显示“收款账户信息暂未公布”时，请联系客服获取，不要自行猜测收款账号。
3. 到“我的订单”查看订单类型、金额、时间和状态。

已转账但余额没变化时，记录转账时间、金额和凭证，通过官网“联系我们”联系平台，不要重复转账。

## 我的资料与实名认证 {#profile}

1. 打开“我的资料”，核对用户名、邮箱和余额。
2. 需要实名时，按页面完成“法定代表人认证”和“企业认证”（不支持个体工商户），使用本人或本企业的真实资料。
3. 提交后回到这里查看“审核中”“已认证”或“认证未通过”。

页面要求补充资料时按提示补齐；不要在公开聊天里发送身份证件或认证材料。修改密码在右上角账号菜单的“修改密码”。

## 卖家中心 {#seller}

左侧“卖家中心”用于节点供货商和插件开发者的入驻、收款与结算，见[节点供货商](/docs/market-supplier)。卖家中心的实名认证（人脸核身）在“实名认证”里办理。卖家中心未开通时会提示“卖家中心暂未开通”。
body.en:
The licence centre (licence portal) handles everything about your control-plane licences: viewing and renewing them, generating the install command, topping up, orders and your profile. Nodes, sites and users are managed in your own control-plane console.

## View your licences {#licenses}

1. Sign in and open "My licences" on the left.
2. Switch between "In use", "Expiring", "Overdue", "Deleted" and "All" with the tabs. A trial counts as "Expiring" in its last 3 days, other licences in their last 30 days; a new trial shows "Normal" with the days left. Choose "All" if unsure.
3. To find one licence, search by licence ID, product, IP, domain or note, or filter by product and expiry (within 7, 30 or 90 days).
4. Check product, "Licensed IP", "Licensed domain", nodes, licence expiry, service expiry, status and note. Licensed IP and domain can be copied; several domains show "+N", hover to see them all.
5. Click a licence for details: purchase information, licence details (licensed IP and domain, licence code, resets left) and the install instructions on the right.

An empty list does not mean a licence was deleted: clear the search and filters and switch to "All". If it is still missing, make sure you are signed in with the account that bought or claimed it; give the platform the order time or number and never share a full activation credential.

"Licensed domain" is the console domain reported by the control plane; it shows "not reported" until the control plane reports one.

## Buy, claim a free licence or renew {#purchase}

1. On "My licences", look at the licence plan cards at the top: nodes, price, term and how many each account may claim.
2. Click "Buy now", choose the plan and term and enter the control-plane IP (the server's public IP; only this IP can activate and download the console).
3. Check the amount. A free licence shows "Free, no payment needed"; just confirm. Paid licences are charged to your balance; top up first if it is short.
4. Check the new licence under "My licences" and the order under "My orders".

To renew, tick a licence and click "Batch renew", or click "Renew" on its row, then confirm plan and term. A free licence can be upgraded in place with "Upgrade licence" in its details; the installed console and control-plane IP stay the same.

If the page asks for identity verification first, follow "Verify identity". If you have claimed a free licence before, look under "In use" and "All". If an order or payment is unclear, check "My orders" before submitting again.

## Change the control-plane IP {#master-ip}

Only the registered control-plane IP can activate and download the console. If the server's public IP changed before installing:

1. Open the licence details and click "Change master IP".
2. In "Change control-plane IP" enter the new public IP, check old and new, and click "Confirm". The old IP can no longer activate or download. At most 10 changes per 24 hours; "Resets left" in the details shows how many remain.
3. Check the change under "Change history" in the dialog.

## Generate the install command {#install}

In the licence details, under the install instructions on the right, click "One-click install script" → "Generate install command" → "Copy". See [install the control plane](/docs/install-control).
